name: Circle recall
when: a person brief whose venues are shared with people already harvested (the circle: hosts publishing the people who share the person's small hosts)
shape: site:<circle host> "first * last" — one probe, a second only if the first shows the name

yields: a small host learned on one person (Alameda, Damage, Stir to Action, the Matrix) tried on the next before the open web is asked
misses: a person with no venue in common with anyone harvested; hosts with too many people (excluded above 40)
